motto1:
Genius only means hard-working all one's life.
——Mendeleyev
天才只意味着终身不懈地努力。——门捷列耶夫
motto2:
The man who has made up his mind to win will never say "impossible". ——Bonaparte Napoleon
凡是决心取得胜利的人是从来不说不可能的。——拿破仑. B.
motto3:
There is no such thing as a great talent without great will - power. ——Balzac
没有伟大的意志力，便没有雄才大略。——巴尔扎克
motto4:
Cease to struggle and you cease to live.
——Thomas Carlyle
生命不止，奋斗不息。——卡莱尔
motto5:
A strong man will struggle with the storms of fate.——Thomas Addison
强者能同命运的风暴抗争。——爱迪生
motto6:
Living without an aim is like sailing without a compass.——John Ruskin
生活没有目标，犹如航海没有罗盘。——罗斯金
motto7:
Live a noble and honest life. Reviving past times in your old age will help you to enjoy your life again.
过一种高尚而诚实的生活。当你年老时回想起过去，你就能再一次享受人生。
motto8:
Accept what was and what is, and you'll have more positive energy to pursue what will be.
接受过去和现在的模样，才会有能量去追寻自己的未来。
motto9:
Behind every successful man there's a lot u unsuccessful years. ——Bob Brown
每个成功者的后面都有很多不成功的岁月。——鲍博·布朗
motto10:
Enrich your life today. Yesterday is history，and tomorrow is mystery.
充实今朝，昨日已成过去，明天充满神奇。
motto11:
The secret of success is constancy to purpose.
成功的秘密在于始终如一地忠于目标。
motto12:
Between two stools one falls to the ground.
脚踏两头要落空。
motto13:
You have to believe in yourself. That's the secret of success. ——Charles Chaplin
人必须有自信，这是成功的秘密。——卓别林
motto14:
Success grows out of struggles to overcome difficulties.
成功来自于克服困难的斗争。
motto15:
The dictionary is the only place where success comes before work.
只有在字典中，成功才会出现在工作之前。
motto16:
There are no shortcuts to any place worth going.
到任何值得去的地方都没有捷径。
motto17:
You're uinique, nothing can replace you.
你举世无双，无人可以替代。
motto18:
Great works are performed not by strengh, but by perseverance.——Samuel Johnson
完成伟大的事业不在于体力，而在于坚韧不拔的毅力。——约翰逊. S.
motto19:
Until you make peace with who you are, you'll never be content with what you have.
除非你能和真实的自己和平相处，否则你永远不会对已拥有的东西感到满足。
motto20:
Don't cry for it came to an end, smile because it began.
不要为它的结束而哭，应当为它的开始而笑。
motto21:
Keep trying no matter how hard it seems. it will get easier.
坚持不懈，难也变易。
motto22:
True mistery of any skill takes a lifetime.
对任何技能的掌握都需要一生的刻苦操练。
motto23:
The first wealth is health .——Ralph Waldo Emerson
健康是人生第一财富。——爱默生. R. W.
motto24:
Where there is life, there is hope.
有生命必有希望。
motto25:
What makes life dreary is the want of motive.——George Eliot
没有了目的，生活便郁闷无光。——乔治·埃略特
motto26:
At twenty years of age , the will reigns; at thirty , the wit ; and at forty , the judgment .——Benjamin Franklin
二十岁时起支配作用的是意志,三十岁时是机智,四十岁时是判断。——富兰克林 . B.
motto27:
Shallow men believe in luck.Self-trust is the first secret of success.
肤浅的人相信运气，而成功的第一秘诀是自信。
motto28:
I have no secret of success but hard work.
除辛勤工作之外，我别无成功的秘诀。
motto29:
If you fail, don't forget to learn your lesson.
如果你失败了，千万别忘了汲取教训。
motto30:
I have nothing to offer but blood, boil, tears and sweat. ——Winston Churchill
我能奉献的没有其它，只有热血、辛劳、眼泪与汗水。——丘吉尔.W.
motto31:
Sweat is the lubricant of success.
汗水是成功的润滑剂。
motto32:
A contented mind is the greatest blessing a man can enjoy in this world.
知足是人生在世最大的幸事。
motto33:
That man is the richest whose pleasure are the cheapest.
能处处寻求快乐的人才是最富有的人。
motto34:
You make the failure complete when you stop trying.
当你停止尝试的时候，你就完全失败了。
motto35:
If winter comes , can spring be far behind?
——P. B. Shelley , British poet
冬天来了，春天还会远吗？——雪莱. P. B.
motto36:
Will, work and wait are the pyramidal cornerstones for success.
意志、工作和等待是成功的金字塔的基石。
motto37:
Success often depends upon knowing how long it will take to succeed.
成功常常取决于知道需要多久才能成功。
motto38:
Think great thoughts and you will be great!
心怀伟大的理想，你将会变得伟大。
motto39:
Only those who have the patience to do simple things perfectly ever acquire the skill to do difficult things easily.
只有有耐心圆满完成简单工作的人，才能够轻而易举的完成困难的事。
motto40:
Gods determine what you're going to be.
——Julius Erving
人生的奋斗目标决定你将成为怎样的人。——欧文
motto41:
A man can succeed at almost anything for which he has unlimited enthusiasm.
无论何事，只要对它有无限的热情你就能取得成功。
motto42:
If you would hit the mark, you must aim a little above it. Every arrow that flies feels the attraction of earth. -Henry Wadsworth Longfellow.
要想射中靶，必须瞄准比靶略为高些，因为脱弦之箭都受到地心引力的影响。
motto43:
The man who has made up his mind to win will never say "impossible".
凡是决心取得胜利的人是从来不说“不可能的”。
motto44:
If you have great talents, industry will improve them;if you have but moderate abilities, industry will supply their deficiency.
如果你很有天赋，勤勉会使其更加完善;如果你能力一般，勤勉会补足其缺陷。
motto45:
The only limit to our realization of tomorrow will be our doubts of today.
实现明天理想的唯一障碍是今天的疑虑。
motto46:
Don't aim for success if you want it; just do what you love and believe in, and it will come naturally.
如果你想要成功，不要去追求成功;尽管做你自己热爱的事情并且相信它，成功自然到来。
motto47:
One thorn of experience is worth a whole wilderness of warning.
一次痛苦的经验抵得上千百次的告诫。
motto48:
It never will rain roses.When we want to have more roses we must plant trees.
天上不会掉下玫瑰来，如果想要更多的玫瑰，必须自己种植。
motto49:
No man or woman is worth your tears, and the one who is, won't make you cry.
没有人值得你流泪，值得让你这么做的人不会让你哭泣。
motto50:
Each man is the architect of his own fate.
每个人都是自己命运的建筑师。
motto51:
Great works are performed not by strength , but by perseverance.
完成伟大的事业不在于体力，而在于坚韧不拔的毅力。
motto52:
Dare and the world always yields.If it beats you sometimes, dare it again and again and it will succumb.
大胆挑战，世界总会让步。如果有时候你被它打败了，不断地挑战，它总会屈服的。
motto53:
I think success has no rules, but you can learn a lot from failure.——Jean Kerr
我认为成功没有定律,但你可从失败中学到很多东西。——静·科尔
motto54:
All time is no time when it is past.
机不可失，时不再来。
motto55:
Do you love life ? Then do not squander time ; for that's the stuff5 life is made of .——Benjamin Franklin
你热爱生命吗?那么，别浪费时间，因为生命是由时间组成的。——富兰克林. B.
motto56:
Live well, love lots, and laugh often.
善待生活，热爱一切，经常开怀大笑。
motto57:
Don't give up and don't give in.
不要放弃，不要言败!
motto58:
To the world you may be one person, but to one person you may be the world.
对于世界而言，你是一个人;但是对于某个人，你是他的整个世界。
motto59:
To choose time is to save time .——Francis Bacon
合理安排时间就是节约时间。——培根.F.
motto60:
Whatever is worth doing is worth doing well.
任何值得做的，就把它做好。
motto61:
Do not , for one repulse , give up  the purpose that you resolved to effect.
——William Shakespeare
不要只因一次失败，就放弃你原来决心想达到的目的。——莎士比亚.W.
motto62:
There are no secrets to success. It is the result of preparation, hard work, and learning from failure.
成功没有诀窍.它是筹备,苦干以及在失败中汲取教训的结果。
motto63:
A chain is no stronger than its weakest link.
链条的坚固程度取决于它最薄弱的环节。
motto64:
The best preparation for tomorrow is doing your best today.
对明天做好的准备就是今天做到最好!
motto65:
Few things are impossible in themselves; and it is often for want of will, rather than of means, that man fails to succeed.
事情很少有根本做不成的;其所以做不成，与其说是条件不够，不如说是由于决心不够。
motto66:
One needs 3 things to be truly happy living in the world: some thing to do, some one to love, some thing to hope for.
要得到真正的快乐，我们只需拥有三样东西：有想做的事，有值得爱的人，有美丽的梦。
motto67:
Faith will move mountains.
精诚所至，金石为开。
motto68:
Take control of your own desting.
命运掌握在自己手上。
motto69:
Adversity is a good discipline.
苦难是磨练人的好机会。
motto70:
In the end, it's not the years in your life that count. It's the life in your years.
到头来，你活了多少岁不算什么，重要的是，你是如何度过这些岁月的。
motto71:
Great oaks from little acorns grow.
万丈高楼平地起。
motto72:
A man can fail many times, but he isn't a failure until he begins to blame somebody else.——J. Burroughs
一个人可以失败很多次，但是只要他没有开始责怪旁人，他还不是一个失败者。——巴勒斯
motto73:
A friend without faults will never be found.
没有缺点的朋友是永远找不到的。
motto74:
If you are doing your best,you will not have to worry about failure.
如果你竭尽全力，你就不用担心失败。
motto75:
Don't try so hard, the best things come when you least expect them to.
不要着急，最好的总会在最不经意的时候出现。
motto76:
He is wise that knows when he's well enough.
知足的人是聪明的人。
motto77:
A man is not old as long as he is seeking something. A man is not old until regrets take the place of dreams. ——J. Barrymore
只要一个人还有追求，他就没有老。直到后悔取代了梦想，一个人才算老。——巴里摩尔
motto78:
If there were no clouds, we should not enjoy the sun.
吃得苦中苦，方知甜中甜。
motto79:
Perseverance can sometimes equal genius in its results.
毅力在效果上有时能同天才相比。
motto80:
An aim in life is the only fortune worth finding.——Robert Louis Stevenson
生活的目标，是唯一值得寻找的财富。——史蒂文森
motto81:
Experience is the mother of wisdom.
智慧来自经验。
motto82:
If you don't aim high you will never hit high.
不立大志，难攀高峰。
motto83:
However mean your life is, meet it and live it; do not shun it and call it hard names.
不论你的生活如何卑贱，你要面对它生活，不要躲避它，更别用恶言咒骂它。
motto84:
It is the first step that costs.
万事开头难。
motto85:
All that you do, do with your might; things done by halves are never done right.
做一切事情都应尽力而为，半途而废永远不行。
motto86:
Ideal is the beacon. Without ideal , there is no secure direction ; without direction , there is no life .——Leo Tolstoy
理想是指路明灯。没有理想，就没有坚定的方向;没有方向，就没有生活。——托尔斯泰.L.
motto87:
I succeeded because I willed it; I never hesitated.
我成功是因为有决心，从不犹豫。
motto88:
Every man is best know to himself.
自己最了解自己。
motto89:
No matter how bad your heart has been broken, the world doesn't stop for your grief. The sun comes right back up the next day.
不管你有多痛苦，这个世界都不会为你停止转动。太阳依旧照样升起。
motto90:
Persistent in prosperity, and in adversity.
在顺境中执着，在逆境中沉着。
motto91:
Labour is often the father of pleasure.
勤劳常为快乐之源。
motto92:
Never underestimate your power to change yourself!
永远不要低估你改变自我的能力!
motto93:
Every noble work is at first impossible.
每一个伟大的工程最初看起来都是不可能做到的!
motto94:
Whatever happens, happens for a reason.
任何事情的发生都有原因的。
motto95:
Winners do what losers don't want to do.
胜利者做失败者不愿意做的事!
motto96:
Happiness is a way station between too much and too little.
幸福是太多和太少之间的一站。
motto97:
Don't part with your illusions . When they are gone you may still exist , but you have ceased to live.——Mark Twain
不要放弃你的幻想。当幻想没有了以后，你还可以生存，但是你虽生犹死。——马克·吐温
motto98:
You cannot improve your past, but you can improve your future. Once time is wasted, life is wasted.
你不能改变你的过去，但你可以让你的未来变得更美好。一旦时间浪费了，生命就浪费了。
motto99:
Energy and persistence conquer all things.——Benjamin Franklin
能量加毅力可以征服一切。——富兰克林
motto100:
Try not to become a man of success but rather try to become a man of value. ——A. Einstein
不要为成功而努力，要为做一个有价值的人而努力。——爱因斯坦
